package rulefixtures

import "net/http"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_garbage_collection_cleanup_response_body_not_drained_for_reuse: Layer: Garbage collection and cleanup. Flag HTTP response handling that closes bodies without draining when connection reuse matters.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario541Positive(url string) (int, error) {
	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	return resp.StatusCode, nil
}

func scenario541FetchMultiple(urls []string) []int {
	statuses := make([]int, 0, len(urls))
	for _, u := range urls {
		if code, err := scenario541Positive(u); err == nil {
			statuses = append(statuses, code)
		}
	}
	return statuses
}
